# The cases of the corpus of gets (compare/gets/corpus.py); the format: host/recon/casefile.py. src = src/cmd/gets.c.

== one-line
# src: the first line, then exit 0
-- in
first
second
-- case
step: gets
stdin: in

== empty-line
-- in

second
-- case
step: gets
stdin: in

== eof
# src: at the end of the input without an argument: exit 1
-- in
-- case
step: gets
stdin: in

== eof-arg
# src: with an argument: an empty line, exit 0
-- in
-- case
step: gets default
stdin: in

== no-newline
-- in
-- case
host: printf 'abc' > in
step: gets
stdin: in

== long
-- in

-- case
step: gets
stdin: in

== twice
# unbuffered: the second gets reads the second line
-- in
one
two
three
-- case
step: gets
stdin: in
